title: Sparse-reference quantum chemistry review: original figure provenance

hero.method: Built-in image_gen tool; original new image generation, no reference images
hero.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original finished editorial cover for a rigorous quantum chemistry seminar review; wide landscape EXACT 16:9, high resolution.
Primary request: A beautiful, visually arresting conceptual artwork in the language of hand-carved printmaking and low sculptural relief. One sparse reference form and one separate finely textured residual form are BOTH compared with the SAME larger target impression. This common target and two distinct comparisons are the main event. This is an artistic metaphor for energy estimation from overlaps, not a diagram or a real apparatus.
Scene: An almost front-facing, gently oblique view of a restrained printmaking-like construction on a deep muted burnt-sienna surface. In the broad center lies one large, roughly oval near-black ink impression on thick warm ochre paper. Its abstract organic edge and a subtle, sophisticated dark-green internal carved grain suggest a complicated target pattern without depicting an actual molecule or wavefunction. Near its left edge sits a smaller pale bone-colored printing form with a very sparse cluster of a few broad, clean angular carved islands. Near its right edge sits a separate muted pine-green printing form whose surface carries a finer, intricate abstract engraved grain and a complementary open sweep. Both forms turn inward and lightly overlap or touch distinct edges of the SAME large central target paper, as if aligning two different comparisons against it. Keep all three roles distinct and immediately legible. These are quiet abstract relief forms, not a collection of tools.
Medium and style: Sophisticated original reduction woodcut / tactile low relief editorial illustration, rich handmade ink texture, minute dry-paper fibers, carefully judged coarse-versus-fine pattern, irregular carved edges, restrained shadows, museum-quality craft. Broad flat areas and bold silhouettes with elegant detail only at large scale. No imitation of any named artist or publication.
Composition: Wide 16:9 frame; all scientifically meaningful objects live safely in the middle 70% of the width and middle 70% of the height. One calm cohesive composition with strong central focus, visual tension between spare marks and fine grain, generous margins. The main sparse form and residual form must remain separately visible at 320 by 180 thumbnail size. No panels, diagram arrows, labels, axis marks, human hands, printing rollers, machines, furniture, extraneous decoration or botanical forms.
Lighting and palette: Warm raking light reveals shallow engraved relief and paper grain. Muted burnt sienna, deep pine green, ink charcoal and a limited bone-white accent; matte print surfaces, no luminescence, no glossy metal, no science-fiction atmosphere.
Text: Absolutely no text, letters, numerals, equations, logos or watermark.
Scientific constraints: Sparse reference and residual are conceptually different comparison patterns against the same target. Do not make a physical spatial partition of a molecule. Do not imply copying, compressing or error-free reconstruction of an unknown quantum state. Do not depict a physical quantum computer, actual measurement data, a circuit, a performance graph or a literal molecular structure. Shapes, engraved marks, distances and counts carry NO quantitative meaning. Two forms represent two repeated measurement channels, not a claim of two shots total.
Avoid: Robots, brains, circuit boards, qubit spheres, bonds or ball-and-stick molecules, neon waves, galaxies, glass architecture, translucent stacked time sheets, repeated rectangular bays, funnels or small boxes, photographic devices, clip art, decorative math, graphs, extra cards, logos, text.
hero.processing: Original PNG preserved. RGB derivatives were resampled without distortion to 1664 × 936, using a subpixel horizontal edge crop to fit the exact 16:9 article slot. No content was composited or retouched. PNG and WebP metadata contain no EXIF/GPS fields or private host paths.
hero.source: Original conceptual artwork; scientific relation informed by Lenihan et al., arXiv:2610.26689v1, §2.1 equations (1)–(4) and Methods equations (6)–(7). No third-party figure or artwork used as input.
hero.caption_ko: 성긴 기준판과 별도의 잔차판을 같은 표적 인상에 대조하는 장면은, 기준·잔차상태와 표적상태의 두 중첩확률로 에너지를 추정하는 발상을 상징한다. 실제 분자·측정 장치·정량 데이터가 아닌 AI 생성 개념 일러스트이며, 두 번의 샷으로 측정이 끝난다는 뜻은 아니다.
hero.caption_en: A sparse reference plate and a separate residual plate are compared with one target impression, symbolizing energy estimation from the target state's overlaps with reference and residual states. This AI-generated conceptual illustration depicts no molecule, measurement apparatus or quantitative data; it does not imply that two shots suffice.
hero.alt_ko: 성긴 무늬의 기준판과 세밀한 무늬의 잔차판이 하나의 큰 표적 인상에 가까이 놓인 판화풍 개념 그림.
hero.alt_en: A printmaking-inspired conceptual scene with a sparse reference plate and a finely textured residual plate placed against one larger target impression.
scientific_invariants: The reference motif and residual motif have separate roles and both address the same target.
Spatial overlap of paper-like plates is a metaphor, not Hilbert-space geometry, a physical molecular partition or measured overlap probabilities.
Pattern counts, object sizes, grain, distances and colors do not encode determinant counts, amplitudes, energies or shot budgets.
Two comparison motifs represent repeated measurement channels, not two total shots or exactness for arbitrary approximate states.
No actual molecular structure, circuit, apparatus, wavefunction or performance data is depicted.
Precise orthogonality, estimator conditions and ground-state sign belong to the article's deterministic diagrams and equations.

review.responsible_role: Codex seminar_cover: concept, generation, scientific metaphor audit, asset QA

2026-10-20_quasi-riemann-ai-proof: dark teal critical strip and gold central line

review.full_size: Inspected. Three separate roles remain visible; no text, data, molecular bonds, circuit or hardware appears. Dense center can evoke an organic/fossil-like print, so caption establishes the abstract relation.
review.thumbnail_320x180: Inspected. Sparse angular left motif, large central target and fine-grain right motif remain separable.
review.mobile: Inspected at 390 × 219 with full 16:9 image. All roles remain visible. Use the complete 16:9 frame for article and review-hub cards.
review.grayscale: Inspected. Pale sparse plate, large dark target impression and darker fine-grain residual remain distinguishable by shape, area and grain.
review.crop_limit: Diagnostic 4:3 center crop loses outer edges of the comparison plates. Arbitrary square or portrait crop is not approved; retain the complete 16:9 frame.
review.title_swap: Compared conceptually with the four recent topics. Two differing comparison patterns against one common target suit the overlap-estimator review; reuse, critical zeros, hardware platforms and agent workflow would lack their defining relations.
review.deletion: Each small plate has a different comparison role; deleting either removes the two-channel relation. The ground contributes contrast and relief but no scientific claim.
review.metadata: Pillow inspection found 0 EXIF fields in original PNG, final PNG and WebP; final PNG has no metadata keys and WebP only loop/background container fields. Raw PNG C2PA chunk retained in original; no private host paths or EXIF/GPS found in final derivatives.
review.limitations: This artwork cannot teach exact orthogonality, probability ratios, sign conditions, statistical uncertainty or total cost. The caption and deterministic body figures supply those distinctions.

distribution.allowed: Final article HTML/PDF, approved conceptual hero, deterministic educational figures, referenced local styles and licensed fonts according to the publication allowlist.
distribution.excluded: Raw source captures, private research notes, QA images, generated-image source-host paths, email/intake records, and unapproved working assets.
